description: Source code for a class 'quality_test' that performs method call exception testing on module objects within the Odoo framework, including test execution and result formatting.

classes.name: quality_test
classes.description: A class that performs method exception testing on module objects, checking if calling basic methods raises exceptions, and computes a score based on success rate.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the quality_test instance with name, note, installation requirement, and minimum score.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Executes the test by calling search, fields_view_get, and read on each object, counts successes and exceptions, calculates score, and sets result and message.

methods.name: get_result
methods.description: Formats the test results into a table for display, including object name and method call statuses.
